user_story.capability: tag-push and manual recovery runs to resolve one canonical immutable release identity

criteria.behavior: select the requested tag as the canonical release tag

criteria.behavior: stop the release before image validation

user_story.benefit: recovery cannot mutate or bless unrelated images

criteria.behavior: verify that its recorded version equals the canonical release version

criteria.behavior: stop the release without changing the tag
